title: AI Competition Platform: an open-source platform for machine-learning competitions on clinical data

creators.name: Magarelli, Fabio
creators.affiliation: INFANT Research Centre, University College Cork, Cork, Ireland

description:
A web platform for hosting machine-learning competitions on clinical data, built at the INFANT Research Centre, University College Cork. It was used to run a competition to grade the severity of EEG background abnormalities in newborns with hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE).

The platform is a Flask application served by gunicorn behind Traefik, with Firebase (Authentication, Firestore, Storage) as the backend store. Participants upload a CSV of predicted grades; the platform scores each submission on accuracy, F1, precision and recall (macro-averaged) and a weighted Matthews correlation coefficient, and ranks the leaderboard on a per-competition weighted combination of those measures. The weighted MCC implementation is included in this release at app/services/MCC_Weighted.

The competition dataset is not included here; it is published separately on Zenodo under the Scientific Data descriptor referenced below.

This is research software: a minimum viable product written to run one competition. It has not been hardened, audited or maintained as a production service, and the public deployment is no longer served.
notes: Includes the weighted MCC implementation vendored from https://github.com/fabiom91/MCC_Weighted at tag v1.0.0 (commit ed55752f5af1bf704d11b7159904fa7a55857227), BSD 3-Clause.
